title: Chloe
description:
Chloe is a beautiful Black Silver Shaded Tortie with white, featuring a soft, intricately blended coat and striking blue eyes that give her a truly distinctive and elegant presence.

She carries a calm, intelligent nature with a quiet confidence, often observing her surroundings before engaging. Chloe shows the classic Maine Coon temperament - relaxed, gentle and affectionate within her environment.

With her elegant features and composed personality, Chloe is a cherished part of the Gimaine family.
